question: Which statement is correct regarding the general and particular solutions of a differential equation?
explanation: By definition, the general solution contains as many arbitrary constants as the order; a particular solution is free from arbitrary constants.

options.A: General solution contains no arbitrary constant and particular solution contains arbitrary constants.
options.B: Both general and particular solutions contain arbitrary constants.
options.C: General solution contains arbitrary constants; particular solution is free from arbitrary constants.
options.D: No difference between general and particular solutions.
